source.note: 1990 Topps is one 792-card base series. VCS models the three direct-pack insert families linked to the release: 1989 All-Star Game Commemorative Set (Glossy All-Stars), 1989 Rookies Commemorative Set (Glossy Rookies), and Batting Leaders. Collector's Edition (Tiffany), Glossy Send-Ins, the Glossy Rookies foil test issue, Topps Company Store issues, and wax-box-bottom material are excluded from normal VCS packs. The scarce blackless printing-error family, including the Frank Thomas no-name-on-front card, is not assigned invented pack odds and is not modeled as a normal pack Product Set in this draft.

excludeNonPackIssuedRelatedSets: 1989 Rookies Commemorative Set (Glossy Rookies) Foil Test Issue
decisions.blacklessVariationHandling: The 13-card blackless printing-error group is intentionally excluded from normal VCS pack modeling because no defensible insertion ratio is available. This includes the iconic Frank Thomas #414 no-name-on-front variation. It can be added later as a special non-pack chase family if desired.
decisions.packChannelAbstraction: VCS uses one universal 16-card wax-style pack. Insert families that were originally exclusive to rack, jumbo, or K-Mart blister formats are normalized by card volume instead of pretending their original container-specific odds apply literally to a wax pack.

normalizedInsertOdds.glossyAllStars: 1 per 46-card rack pack -> approximately 1 per 2.88 VCS 16-card packs -> stored as 1:3
normalizedInsertOdds.glossyRookies: 1 per 43-card jumbo pack -> approximately 1 per 2.69 VCS 16-card packs -> stored as 1:3
normalizedInsertOdds.battingLeaders: 1 per 101-card K-Mart blister pack -> approximately 1 per 6.31 VCS 16-card packs -> stored as 1:6

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: One canonical VCS card per printed number 1-792. True RC labels come only from the linked TCDB rookie index. Error/correction/variation detail is kept out of Player.

productSets.name: Glossy All-Stars
productSets.notes: Originally one per rack pack. VCS normalizes the rack-pack distribution to approximately 1:3 of its universal 16-card packs.

productSets.name: Glossy Rookies
productSets.notes: Originally one per jumbo pack. One-asterisk/two-asterisk copyright variations are collapsed to one canonical VCS card per numbered checklist entry.

productSets.name: Batting Leaders
productSets.notes: Originally one per K-Mart blister pack. VCS normalizes the 101-card blister distribution to approximately 1:6 of its universal 16-card packs.
